tasting_events.policy_text: Cellar & Co. hosts a wine tasting every Friday from 6pm to 8pm at the Rockville store. It costs $15 per person, and the $15 is credited toward any bottle bought that evening. Reserve a spot at cellarandco.example/events. Tastings are 21+ with a government ID. Private group tastings for 8 to 20 people start at $35 per person and need to be booked at least 2 weeks ahead.

gift_cards.description: buying, using or checking gift cards
gift_cards.policy_text: Cellar & Co. sells digital gift cards from $25 to $500, delivered instantly by email, and physical gift cards at the Rockville store. Gift cards never expire and work online and in store. Check a balance at cellarandco.example/giftcards. The person redeeming a gift card for alcohol must be 21 or older. Lost physical cards can be replaced with the purchase receipt.
